justicia_brandegeeana.why: reads as a dense, glossy broadleaf shrub at 5 m and 15 m with stems showing at the base; too tidy and egg-shaped (real Justicia is lax and arching) and no bracts (no scan, not invented)

salvia_leucantha.why: narrow-leaf grey-green bush but the leaf bank (ginger-lily blades) is olive/yellowish and the plant is a dense dome: without the purple spikes (no scan) it is not recognisable as Salvia leucantha; reads as a generic narrow-leaf shrub

acorus_gramineus.why: reads as a fine arching sedge/Acorus tuft at 5 m and a small grass tuft at 15 m; blades are scan cut-outs, widths squeezed (form-class)

alpinia_zerumbet.why: upright leafy canes with large lanceolate leaves reads as a ginger-family plant; more upright than the arching real habit; not in the current layout

farfugium_japonicum.why: glossy kidney-shaped leaves on petioles in a basal mound reads as a leopard plant/taro-type; petioles a little straight and leaves unspotted

fatsia_japonica.why: palmate, lobed, glossy leaves on stout stems read as a Fatsia at 5 m and 15 m; outline is generated (not scanned), lower third of the stems is bare

jasminum_sambac.why: glossy dark-green foliage panel on a trellis with trailing shoots, reads as a climber at 5/15 m; uniform (no visible stems), no flowers (no scan)

trachelospermum_jasminoides.why: glossy ovate leaves on a trellis: the one species-faithful plant (the leaf scan is the species); uniform coverage, no flowers

petrea_volubilis.why: large dark leaves read as a leafy climber but not as Petrea: no purple calyces (not scanned, not invented), leaf bank is jasmine/ginger blades (form-class)

vitis_vinifera.why: lobed leaf shape on a vine panel, but a uniform wall of leaves with yellow translucent edge glow, no tendrils or bunches; outline generated

lagerstroemia_indica.why: leaf-on and leaf-off states (see both sheets): a 4.5 m x 4.0 m pruned multi-stem tree, 4 stems clear to 2.2 m, forking limbs, round head; reads as a real tree at 5 m and 15 m; leaf-off is the stronger of the two. Mottled CC0 plane bark, glossy leaf cards are jasmine leaves (form-class)
